paragraphs: We are a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company with a pipeline of novel biologic therapeutic candidates, developed using our proprietary modular protein engineering platforms. We leverage our innovative protein engineering technologies and deep understanding of target biology to create therapeutic candidates with attributes and mechanisms we believe to be superior to current approaches and applicable to a range of challenging, validated targets with high potential.

On May 29, 2024, Inhibrx, Inc., or the Former Parent, effected the spin-off of INBRX-101, an optimized, recombinant alpha-1 antitrypsin, or AAT, augmentation therapy in a registrational trial for the treatment of patients with alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency, upon which the Former Parent completed a distribution to holders of its shares of common stock of 92% of the issued and outstanding shares of our common stock, or the Distribution. On May 30, 2024, the Former Parent completed a series of internal restructuring transactions, or the Separation.

On May 30, 2024, the Former Parent completed the merger, or the Merger, of Art Acquisition Sub, Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary of Aventis Inc., or the Acquirer, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Sanofi S.A., or Sanofi, with and into the Former Parent with the Former Parent continuing as the surviving entity. Pursuant to the Merger (i) all assets and liabilities primarily related to INBRX-101, or the 101 Business, were transferred to the Acquirer; and (ii) by way of the Separation, we acquired the assets and liabilities and corporate infrastructure associated with its ongoing programs, INBRX-106 and ozekibart (INBRX-109), and its discovery pipeline, as well as the remaining close-out obligations related to its previously terminated program, INBRX-105. From and after the closing, Inhibrx continues to operate as a stand-alone, publicly traded company focused on ozekibart and INBRX-106, both of which are clinical-stage programs.

For periods prior to the spin-off, descriptions of historical business activities are presented as if the spin-off had already occurred, and the Former Parent's activities related to such assets and liabilities had been performed by us. Refer to Note 1 to our consolidated financial statements included elsewhere in this Annual Report for further discussion of the underlying basis used to prepare the consolidated financial statements. The operating results presented in our historical financial statements prior to the Merger and in connection with the Separation and the Merger may not be indicative of our results following the Merger and Separation.

Our current clinical pipeline of therapeutic candidates includes ozekibart and INBRX-106, both of which utilize our multivalent formats where the precise valency can be optimized in a target-centric way to mediate what we believe to be the most appropriate agonist function:

We have assembled a team with deep scientific, manufacturing, and clinical experience in discovering and developing protein therapeutics, as well as an accomplished commercial team with the expertise we believe to successfully bring our therapeutic candidates, if approved, to market. Our in-house capabilities span the disciplines of discovery, protein engineering, cell biology, translational research, chemistry, manufacturing and controls, or CMC, clinical development, and commercialization. Members of our team bring experience from multiple organizations including Genentech, Inc., Gilead Sciences, Inc., Merck & Co., Novartis AG, Pfizer Inc., and Roche. Our board of directors is comprised of individuals with proven business and scientific accomplishments and significant operating knowledge of our company.

Our mission is to discover and develop effective biologic treatments applicable to a range of challenging, validated targets with high potential to help people with life-threatening conditions. We are a biopharmaceutical company aiming to develop a differentiated and sustainable product portfolio by focusing on the following:

Since entering the clinic, we have made great strides in our clinical programs, with the successful completion of two registration-enabling trials. In May 2024, we completed a successful Merger and Separation with Sanofi for the

purchase of our INBRX-101 program for alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency disorder. Positive data from that registrational program read out in October 2025. In October 2025, we announced positive data from our ozekibart (INBRX-109) registration-enabling trial in advanced or metastatic, unresectable chondrosarcoma.
Both ozekibart and INBRX-106 have key data or milestone events expected in 2026.

We continue to focus our internal clinical development where we believe we can create effective and flexible solutions to address the challenges of validated targets in areas with a high unmet medical need. Our modular protein engineering platforms enable us to efficiently identify optional therapeutic formats customized to the target biology.

paragraphs: Investing in our common stock involves a high degree of risk. You should carefully consider the risks and uncertainties described below, together with all of the other information in this Annual Report, including our consolidated financial statements and related notes, before investing in our common stock. The risks and uncertainties described below are not the only ones we face. Additional risks and uncertainties that we are unaware of, or that we currently believe are not material, may also become important factors that affect us. If any of the following risks occur, our business, operating results, financial condition, and prospects could be materially harmed. In that event, the price of our common stock could decline, and you could lose part or all of your investment.

Our business is subject to a number of risks of which you should be aware before making an investment decision. These risks are discussed more fully in the section of this Annual Report titled "Risk Factors". These risks include, among others, the following:

•We have a limited operating history, have incurred significant operating losses since our inception and anticipate that we will continue to incur significant losses for the foreseeable future. We may never generate product revenue or become profitable in the future, or if we achieve profitability in the future, we may not be able to sustain it.

•Biotechnology product development is a highly speculative undertaking and involves a substantial degree of uncertainty. We have never generated any revenue from product sales and may never be profitable.

•We expect we will need to raise substantial additional funds to advance development of our therapeutic candidates, and we cannot guarantee this additional funding will be available on acceptable terms or at all. Failure to obtain this funding when needed may force us to delay, limit or terminate our development efforts and, if any of our therapeutic candidates are approved, our commercialization efforts.
•We may be adversely affected by the effects of inflation.

paragraphs: 本公司為一家臨牀階段的生物科技製藥公司，擁有新型生物製劑治療候選藥物的產品線，這些候選藥物係利用本公司專屬的模組化蛋白工程平台所開發。本公司運用創新蛋白工程技術與對目標生物學的深入理解，以開發具備我們認為優於現有方法之屬性與機制的治療候選藥物，並適用於多種具有高潛力的挑戰性且已驗證之目標。
2024年5月29日，Inhibrx, Inc.（或稱前母公司）執行INBRX-101的分拆，INBRX-101為一種優化後的重組α-1抗胰蛋白酶（AAT）增強治療法，用於註冊臨牀試驗中治療α-1抗胰蛋白酶缺乏症患者。前母公司於此同時完成對持有其普通股股東的股份發行，發放本公司92%已發行且現存普通股股份（或稱分拆）。2024年5月30日，前母公司完成一系列內部重整交易（或稱分離交易）。

2024年5月30日，前母公司完成Art Acquisition Sub, Inc.（為Aventis Inc.（或稱 acquiring 公司）之 wholly-owned 子公司）與Sanofi S.A.（或稱Sanofi）之 wholly-owned 子公司與前母公司合併，前母公司繼續為存續公司。根據合併（i）與INBRX-101相關之主要資產與負債（或稱101業務）已轉移至 acquiring 公司；（ii）透過分離交易，本公司取得與其進行中計畫INBRX-106與ozekibart（INBRX-109）相關之資產與負債與企業基礎設施，以及與其先前終止計畫INBRX-105相關之剩餘結案義務。自合併完成後，Inhibrx持續作為一家獨立且公開上市之公司運作，專注於ozekibart與INBRX-106，兩者皆為臨牀階段之計畫。
於分拆前之期間，歷史業務活動之描述皆視為分拆已發生，且前母公司與相關資產與負債之活動皆由本公司執行。請參閱本年度報告中其他部分所附之財務報表附註1，以進一步說明用以準備合併財務報表之基礎。於合併前之歷史財務報表與與分離及合併相關之營運結果，可能無法反映於合併與分離後之結果。
本公司目前之臨牀產品線包含ozekibart與INBRX-106，兩者皆運用本公司之多價格式，其中精確價值可於目標導向方式進行最佳化，以調節我們認為最適當之激動功能：
腫瘤學 DR5 四價激動劑 INBRX-106** 腫瘤學 OX40 六價激動劑
* 目前正在研究用於軟骨肉瘤、尤文氏肉瘤、結腸直腸癌以及某些其他實體腫瘤類型。
** 目前正在研究用於非小細胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者及頭頸部鱗狀細胞癌（HNSCC）患者。

我們已組建一支具備深厚科學、製造及臨牀經驗的團隊，專門從事蛋白質治療藥物的發現與開發，同時也擁有具備專業知識的商業團隊，相信能成功將我們的治療藥物候選品項（若獲得核准）推向市場。我們的內部能力涵蓋發現、蛋白質工程、細胞生物學、轉譯研究、化學、製造與管制（CMC）、臨牀開發及商業化等領域。團隊成員來自多家公司，包括基因泰克公司（Genentech, Inc.）、吉利德科學公司（Gilead Sciences, Inc.）、默克公司（Merck & Co.）、諾華公司（Novartis AG）、輝瑞公司（Pfizer Inc.）及羅氏公司（Roche）。我們的董事會成員皆為具備卓越商業與科學成就，並對本公司有深厚運營知識的個人。

自進入臨牀階段以來，我們在臨牀計畫中取得了重大進展，成功完成兩項註冊啟動試驗。2024年5月，我們成功完成與賽諾菲（Sanofi）的合併與分離，以取得我們的INBRX-101計畫，用以治療α-1抗胰蛋白酶缺乏症。該註冊計畫的數據於2025年10月釋出。2025年10月，我們宣佈在晚期或轉移性、無法手術切除的軟骨肉瘤患者中，ozekibart（INBRX-109）的註冊啟動試驗結果為正面。

paragraphs: 於 2024 年 5 月 29 日，Inhibrx, Inc.，或稱前母公司，執行了 INBRX-101 的分拆，INBRX-101 是一種經過優化、重組的 alpha-1 抗胰蛋白酶，或稱 AAT，增強治療法，用於登記臨牀試驗，用以治療 alpha-1 抗胰蛋白酶缺乏症患者，於此同時，前母公司完成了向其普通股股東發放 92% 已發行及流通普通股股份的分發，或稱分發。於 2024 年 5 月 30 日，前母公司完成了系列內部重整交易，或稱分離。

於 2024 年 5 月 30 日，前母公司完成了與 Art Acquisition Sub, Inc. 的合併，Art Acquisition Sub, Inc. 是 Aventis Inc. 的全資子公司，或稱買方，買方是 Sanofi S.A. 的全資子公司，或稱 Sanofi，與前母公司合併並吸收前母公司，前母公司繼續作為存續公司。根據合併（i）與 INBRX-101，或稱 101 商業，主要相關的資產與負債已轉移至買方；以及（ii）透過分離，我們取得了與其持續進行計畫 INBRX-106 和 ozekibart（INBRX-109）以及其發現管道相關的資產與負債與企業基礎設施，以及與其先前終止計畫 INBRX-105 相關的剩餘結案義務。
於交易完成後，每位前母公司股東收到：（i）每股 30.00 美元現金，（ii）每持有一股前母公司普通股，即取得一股附條件價值權，代表在達成監管里程碑時可取得 5.00 美元現金的權利，以及（iii）每持有四股前母公司普通股，即取得一張經 SEC 登記、公開上市的 Inhibrx 普通股。
自交易完成後，Inhibrx 繼續作為一家獨立、公開上市的公司運作，專注於 ozekibart 和 INBRX-106，這兩個皆為臨牀階段的計畫。
在分拆前的期間，歷史業務活動的描述皆視為分拆已發生，且前母公司與這些資產與負債相關的活動皆由我們執行。請參閱本年度報告其他部分所附的綜合財務報表附註 1，以進一步瞭解用以準備綜合財務報表的基礎。在合併前的期間以及與分離及合併相關的運營結果，可能無法反映我們在合併及分離後的結果。

paragraphs: 投資本公司普通股涉及高度風險。您應謹慎考量下列所描述的風險與不確定性，並配合本年度報告中所有其他資訊，包括我們的合併財務報表及相關附註，再做投資決定。下列所描述的風險與不確定性並非我們唯一面臨的風險。我們可能還會面臨其他未預見或目前認為不具重大影響的風險與不確定性，這些因素可能對我們產生重要影響。若任何下列風險發生，將可能對我們的業務、營運成果、財務狀況與前景造成重大損害。在此情況下，本公司普通股的價格可能下跌，您可能損失全部或部分投資。
我們的業務面臨許多風險，您在做投資決定前應充分了解。這些風險在本年度報告的「風險因素」節中更詳細說明。這些風險包括但不限於以下內容：
•我們的營運歷史有限，自成立以來已產生重大營運虧損，且預期在可預見的未來仍將持續產生重大虧損。我們可能永遠無法產生產品收入或實現盈利，或即使未來實現盈利，也可能無法維持盈利。
•生物科技產品的開發是一項高度投機的活動，並伴隨著相當程度的不確定性。我們從來未從產品銷售中產生任何收入，且可能永遠無法實現盈利。
•我們預期將需要籌集大量額外資金以推進我們治療候選藥物的開發，且無法保證能以可接受的條件或任何方式取得此額外資金。若無法在需要時取得資金，將迫使我們延遲、限制或終止我們的開發工作，若任何治療候選藥物獲批准，也可能影響我們的商業化工作。
•我們可能因通貨膨脹的影響而受到不利影響。
